targets.title: The sexual overperception bias: Evidence of a systematic bias in men from a survey of naturally occuring events
targets.evidence_quote: This study, using a sample of heterosexual Norwegian students ( n = 308), was carried out as a direct replication of Haselton's (2003) original study of naturally occurring events of sexual misperception.
targets.outcome_quote: The general pattern of findings suggests that this study of Norwegian students—using identical methodology—closely replicates Haselton's (2003) original findings of sex biases in sexual misperception of naturally occurring events.
